findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agriculture-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agriculture-intelligence_crop-weather-exposure-analyze, agriculture-intelligence_commodity-price-series-normalize, agriculture-intelligence_crop-insurance-evidence-check · Private data: agriculture-intelligence_market-risk-report · Public sink: agriculture-intelligence_crop-weather-exposure-analyze, agriculture-intelligence_crop-calendar-validate, agriculture-intelligence_crop-yield-estimate, agriculture-intelligence_commodity-price-series-normalize, agriculture-intelligence_commodity-price-spread-analyze, agriculture-intelligence_fertilizer-cost-per-hectare, agriculture-intelligence_input-cost-compare, agriculture-intelligence_grain-quality-spec-validate, agriculture-intelligence_crop-insurance-evidence-check, agriculture-intelligence_market-risk-report · Destructive: agriculture-intelligence_crop-weather-exposure-analyze, agriculture-intelligence_crop-calendar-validate, agriculture-intelligence_crop-yield-estimate, agriculture-intelligence_commodity-price-series-normalize, agriculture-intelligence_commodity-price-spread-analyze, agriculture-intelligence_fertilizer-cost-per-hectare, agriculture-intelligence_input-cost-compare, agriculture-intelligence_grain-quality-spec-validate, agriculture-intelligence_crop-insurance-evidence-check, agriculture-intelligence_market-risk-report.
